topic: Reviewing session data and gender categorization
summary_markdown: The conversation began with a discussion about missing or unexpected predictive data/sessions. Later, [p1] requested the removal of 'unknown gender' categories and the assignment of genders (male/female) to existing records. While initially questioned regarding potential bias, it was agreed that this categorization could be performed. The session concluded with an agreement to review the data together.
decisions: The team will categorize unknown gender entries into male or female.
action_items: Review the missing/unexpected predictive sessions and data points.
